justification: Woollahra DCP B1's 10 residential precincts had no outlines, so their rules reached no house. The DCP's own precinct maps were fitted to the cadastre lot lines; 5 pass (shape IoU 0.976-0.997, lot-land IoU 0.91-0.998, check pictures read), 5 refused. Loaded 2026-10-21 before merge; live: Darling Point 34 rules, Rose Bay 10, outside 0.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: The outline file holds ids other than the five proven precincts, or the keying rule changes.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Before: dcp_precinct_boundaries had no B1 precinct rows; B1 rows keyed to precinct names reached no house.
falsifiable_check.external_authority: Woollahra DCP 2015 B1 precinct maps (pages 11, 15, 18, 24, 34) fitted to nsw_cadastre_lots lot lines; check pictures in data/woollahra_precincts/checks/.

pre_impl.existing_data: Council layer WDCP 2015 Residential Precincts (MapServer/24) returned 503 all day. fit_site_plans.py extended with a precinct-map mode rather than a new fitter.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Five precinct maps' lot lines do not sit on the current cadastre (line share ~0.25, no unique placement); refused, not forced.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Precinct-map mode in the existing fitter, one outline file, Woollahra loader profile entries, one test.

functions.name: _load
functions.input: the five B1 outlines with inside and outside address anchors
functions.output: 5 rows upserted, every anchor resolved as expected
functions.if_none: an empty file aborts before any write

values.value: 5 of 10 precincts pass; Darling Point line share 0.565 against a 0.5 bar set after that result (picture confirmed)
live: Darling Point 34 B1 rules, Rose Bay 10, no precinct 0

break_it.scenario: A fitted outline sits one block off.
break_it.what_happens: Houses next door would be shown another precinct's rules.
break_it.how: Lot-land IoU >= 0.91 and the check picture shows the edge on lot lines all round; unique placement required.

break_it.scenario: A refused precinct's houses expect B1 rules.
break_it.what_happens: Those houses see no B1 rules for their precinct.
break_it.how: Recorded: five precincts refused; their rules stay unshown until outlined (same as before this change).
break_it.repro: for-property with precinct_id=Manning Road Precinct returns no outline match

break_it.scenario: Paddington or a centre lands in a B1 outline.
break_it.what_happens: Houses outside residential precincts get B1 rules.
break_it.how: Loader anchors: 5 Victoria St Paddington -> Paddington HCA only; 368A New South Head Rd -> Double Bay Centre only.

mutation_analysis: Changing the outline ids fails the new test.

post_merge.db_reset: Already done before merge: 5 outlines loaded, backup woollahra_precinct_boundaries_before_2026-10-21T012231.json.
post_merge.manual_verify: Done live: Darling Point 34, Rose Bay 10, none 0.

residual_risk: B3 (453 rules) still served to all Woollahra houses until all ten precincts are outlined or the may-apply block can show it to the refused precincts.
